newsitem.title: USA: MCA names McGrath senior vice president.
newsitem.headline: MCA names McGrath senior vice president.

text.p: MCA Inc Thursday named Brian McGrath to the post of senior vice president for international business development.
In the newly created position, McGrath will be responsible for developing international business opportunities in support of all divisions.
McGrath has held a number of senior executive positions in entertainment, marketing, investment banking and sports, and most recently served as commissioner of the Thoroughbred Racing Associations.
MCA is a unit of Seagram Co Ltd.
